networks.name: net_triage
networks.description: Tell me what is wrong with your internet. I check it from your browser and explain what to do.
sample_queries: My internet feels really slow right now. What is wrong?
Is wikipedia.org down for everyone or just for me?
Websites will not load on my Windows laptop. How do I fix it?
Give me fix steps for an unstable connection on my iPhone.
Write up my results so I can send them to my internet provider.
मेरे Android फ़ोन पर इंटरनेट बहुत धीमा है, हिंदी में स्टेप बताइए।
Can you restart my router for me?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only.
